latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of amazon-coupon-strategy skill.
- Provides detailed guidance on planning Amazon deals, coupons, and promotions, including Lightning Deals, Prime Exclusive Discounts, BOGO, Vine, and social media codes.
- Offers ready-to-use command set for strategy planning, ROI calculators, event playbooks, and promotional calendar creation.
- Includes best practices, break-even formulas, and event prep timelines for maximizing sales and protecting margin.
- Supplies a 12-month promotional calendar and inventory clearance strategies.
